correctness.rationale: Every one of 65536 masks is classified by the degree-at-most-one induced-subgraph predicate, obtaining 3054 faces. Full 1517-pair discrete-Morse matching on 13568 oriented Hasse incidences is exhaustive and acyclic. Integral Morse degree-four boundary vectors (1,-1,1) and (-1,1,-1) have one unit pivot, so the CW attaching maps give exactly 16 three-spheres and one four-sphere. A separate GF(2) full-chain check agrees; signed integral calculation supplies the stronger conclusion.

value.rationale: The 16-vertex hypercube is a canonical finite nonchordal, symmetric graph and also the fully periodic 4x4 grid. Its first higher-independence homotopy type is a complete natural classification with mixed-dimensional spheres, contrasting with the pure-dimensional ordinary independence case. The exact integral attaching map and reproducible finite matching provide a motivated benchmark rather than an arbitrary graph slice.
